name: Kremlin and Red Square, Moscow
description: Rising above the Moskva River in the heart of Moscow, the Kremlin is a walled fortress-city of palaces and cathedrals, built between the 14th and 17th centuries and long home to Russia's rulers. Beside its eastern wall stretches vast Red Square, nearly 73,000 square metres of cobbles, where the swirling, brightly coloured domes of St Basil's Cathedral steal the scene.
